content:
GOAL: orient in the round workspace and locate the baseline mechanism files before proposing.
READ: list of working directory.
OBSERVED: starting exploration.
EVIDENCE: none yet.
REASONING: the proposal must be implementable against the real code, so I need to see the Stage2 SID pipeline and the Stage3 generator.
OPEN: what files exist; where RQ-VAE quantizer, text encoder, behaviour graph live.

GOAL: deliver the single proposal after checking workspace access and round constraints.
READ: Code Mode exposes no shell/read; MCP resources empty; worked from the brief's measured facts.
OBSERVED: proposal written to be implementable from the brief alone against the described baseline (frozen Stage-1 text geometry, 3x256 RQ-VAE, 24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs, 0.145 s/epoch).
REASONING: chose HOLONOMY-FRAME-SID. Issue 126 rules out radial, Gromov-delta, ancestor-depth and learned-curvature signals but keeps behaviour-contrast; round one says the binding lever is the prefix structure (2201 L3 triples, ~11 items each). The per-prefix hyperbolic triangle (origin, text anchor, successor anchor) has area = behavioural drift of that prefix; Gauss-Bonnet turns the area into a holonomy rotation of that prefix's code frame. It is identically the baseline when b_p = a_p (behaviour off) and identically zero in the Euclidean limit (geometry off), so the coupling is real and both switches are code-level. Rotation is an isometry about the anchor, so no origin-collapse minimum and no trainable-encoder path, avoiding the round-one collapse.
STILL OPEN: exact per-step wall clock (+5 to +10% estimated) and whether successor drift per prefix is sufficiently non-uniform; single run, no ablation arms.
FULL ANSWER TEXT: IDEA holonomy-frame-sid; title 'Behavioural-drift holonomy rotates the per-prefix code frame of the hyperbolic RQ-VAE'; behaviour = training-only directed transitions a->b, row-normalised P(b|a), prefix successor anchor b_p = psi(sum_b v_p(b) z_b) with v_p(b) = mean over i in S_p of P(b|i); geometry = Poincare ball c=1 fixed, area of triangle (o, a_p, b_p) by the hyperbolic law of cosines, holonomy theta_p = -Area; coupling equation c'_{p,k} = exp_{a_p}( R(e1,e2,theta_p) log_{a_p}(c_k) ) used for the level-l nearest-codeword assignment; output SID matrix 24556x3; observables distinct L3 triples (baseline 2201), items-per-triple tail, per-prefix L3 entropy, Stage3 test_recall@10 vs 0.065; ablations b_p:=a_p (behaviour off), theta:=0 with Euclidean distance (geometry off), full run (both on, the only trained arm).
